description.content:
Export workspace data to CSV format.

Args:
    workspace_id: The workspace ID to export
    request: WorkspaceExportRequest object containing filter, sort, search, column_ids, and institution_ids
    token_BEARER: Authentication token
    app_session: Database app_session
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Export purchase orders for a specific column and institution as a CSV file.

Args:
    column_id: Custom column ID containing purchase order data
    institution_id: Institution ID
    is_prev: Whether to use previous content
    token_BEARER: Authentication token
    app_session: Database app_session

Returns:
    CSV file with columns: Supplier, Item, Amount, Date.
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Export purchase orders from smart columns in a workspace as a CSV file.
Args:
    workspace_id: The workspace ID to export purchase orders from
    request: PurchaseOrdersExportRequest object containing filter and search parameters
    filter_json: JSON string for filtering institutions
    sort_json: JSON string for sorting institutions
    token_BEARER: Authentication token
    app_session: Database app_session
    request.institution_ids: Optional list of workspace institution_ids (WorkspaceInstitution UUIDs) to export (if provided, only these rows are exported)
    Each row is one individual purchase item. Columns: Institution, Supplier, Item, Amount, Date, plus any other selected columns (excluding contacts and purchase_orders columns).
